TERMS & CONDITIONS

  • Prices must match the approved quotation.
  • No verbal or WhatsApp changes are permitted.
  • Any variations must be approved in writing by ABS.
  • All deliveries must be accompanied by delivery notes.
  • Invoices must reference this PO number.
  • Payments will be processed only after verification of goods/services and supporting documents.
